description: Shared authority between institutions communities workers and affected publics.
Representative deliberative process with balanced information and formal recommendations.
Local and marginalized communities define futures risks priorities and pathways.
Public voice is connected directly to long-term resource allocation and project selection.
Publics experts and affected users evaluate emerging technologies before lock-in.
Young people advise on long-term policy but authority depends on institutional response duties.
Online participation scales input but risks shallow engagement and digital exclusion.
Public input is requested after decisions are largely framed and influence remains weak.
